headline: Agricultural Field Technician
summary: Agriculture graduate with a year as a field technician for a vegetable and rice seed company in Bataan. I run demonstration plots, scout for pests and diseases, advise farmers on harvesting and conservation practices, and help set up composting from crop residues. I want to specialise in integrated crop management.

projects.name: Tomato demonstration farm
bullets: Set up a half-hectare tomato demo farm with trellising, drip lines and mulching.
Yields were about 30% above the farmers' usual plots and were shown at two field days.

projects.name: Rice straw composting
projects.description: Compared three ways of composting rice straw instead of burning it, and measured the effect on the next crop's soil organic matter.

skills: Integrated pest management and field scouting

experience.title: Agricultural Field Technician
bullets: Manage six demonstration plots of hybrid rice and vegetables across Bataan.
Scout fields weekly and advise farmers on pest and disease control.
Train farmer groups on harvest timing, drying and handling to reduce losses.
Keep plot records and write monthly performance reports for the sales team.

experience.title: Farm Practicum Student
bullets: Assisted in seedling production, transplanting and composting on an organic vegetable farm.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Agriculture, major in Agronomy
